blurb: Mustang Creek Golf Course is a 9-hole golf course located in Taylor, Texas, with a history dating back to 1914. It offers private, family, and corporate memberships with unlimited golf and discounts on pro line equipment. The course hosts annual tournaments including the City Championship and Club Championship, as well as benefit tournaments and weekly Wednesday Scrambles.
